newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor volumes low, traders oppose new rules.
newsitem.headline: India castor volumes low, traders oppose new rules.

text.p: Indian castorseed trading volumes fell on Wednesday as traders continued to oppose new guidelines relating to daily clearing, dealers said.
"Volumes ... remained negligible as leading players are still opposing daily clearing imposed by the exchange authorities," one dealer said of Wednesday's trade.

Castorseed March delivery initially rose to 1,161/1,162 rupees per quintal 1,157/1,158 on the back of overseas interest but prices fell later to 1,156/1,157 rupees on fresh speculative offerings following reports of higher new crop arrivals in producing centres, dealers said.
Trading in the castorseed June delivery began on Wednesday with new contracts quoted at 1,210/1,215 rupees per quintal.
Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 337/338 rupees per 10 kg on stray physical support. Rajkot spot oil was steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
